update_motd_scripts.content:
#!/bin/sh
echo
df -h / | awk 'NR==2 {print "Disk: " $5 " used on /"}'
echo "Uptime: $(uptime -p 2>/dev/null || uptime)"

#!/bin/sh
out="/run/motd-news-cache"
script="w3m -dump https://ubuntu.com/blog/rss.xml 2>/dev/null"
if [ -f "$out" ]; then
  lastrun=$(stat -c %Y "$out" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  expiration=$((lastrun + 86400))
  if [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$expiration" ]; then
    $script > "$out" &
  fi
else
  $script > "$out" &
fi
if [ -s "$out" ]; then
  echo
  head -5 "$out"
fi
